title: Uncover Miami’s Rich History
abstract: Miami is a city with a fascinating past, from its early Native American roots to the modern architectural wonders. Explore the landmarks, stories, and cultural heritage that shaped Miami into what it is today.

packages.title: Historic Miami Walking Tour
packages.description: Walk through the streets of Downtown Miami and discover the city's most iconic historical landmarks with a local historian.

packages.title: Freedom Tower & Cuban Exile Experience
packages.description: Visit the Freedom Tower, known as the Ellis Island of the South, and learn about the history of Cuban immigration to Miami.

packages.title: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens Tour
packages.description: Explore the opulent estate and gardens of Vizcaya, a National Historic Landmark that offers a glimpse into Miami's Gilded Age.

packages.title: Native American Heritage Experience
packages.description: Learn about the indigenous history of Miami with a visit to the Miccosukee Indian Village and a guided tour of the Big Cypress National Preserve.

packages.title: Miami Museum Pass
packages.description: Gain access to multiple museums in Miami with a single pass, including HistoryMiami Museum, the Wolfsonian-FIU, and the Jewish Museum of Florida.

packages.title: Art Deco Architecture History Tour
packages.description: Explore the architectural history of Miami Beach’s Art Deco District with a guided tour focusing on the design, history, and stories behind these iconic buildings.
